technical_and_design_decisions: Use JUnit 5 and Spring Boot test framework for acceptance tests.
Use Testcontainers to manage external dependencies (e.g., Mail server, SFTP server) for source modules.
Use WireMock for mocking HTTP endpoints in http-client processor tests.
Use embedded network servers for reactor-ip and reactor-syslog source module tests.
Use a standard PMML evaluator library (e.g., jpmml-evaluator) for analytic-pmml tests.
Integrate acceptance tests into the existing CI pipeline using Maven Failsafe plugin with separate integration test profile.
assumptions: All source and processor modules already exist in the codebase and only require acceptance test coverage.
The development environment has Docker installed to run Testcontainers for Mail and SFTP tests.
Existing unit tests and build configuration are in place; no new modules or major refactoring needed.
The CI pipeline supports separate integration test phases and can be configured to run acceptance tests.
Each module's acceptance test will be self-contained and can be run independently.
The developer has full access to module documentation and existing source code for analysis.
Effort estimates are based on a senior developer familiar with Spring Framework, Spring Integration, and testing practices.
No additional requirements for performance or security testing are implied by the user stories.

activities.activity_description: Review existing module structure, unit tests, and design acceptance test strategy for all eight modules. Create test plan and identify shared test utilities.
Set up Docker Compose files for Testcontainers (Mail server, SFTP server), create base test classes and utilities for acceptance tests.
Implement acceptance tests for the Mail source module using Greenmail or similar embedded mail server to verify inbound email reception.
Implement acceptance tests for the reactor-ip source module using an embedded TCP/UDP server to verify network data reception.
Implement acceptance tests for the reactor-syslog source module using an embedded syslog server to verify syslog message ingestion.
Implement acceptance tests for the SFTP source module using Testcontainers with an SSH/SFTP server to verify file retrieval and directory polling.
Implement acceptance tests for the aggregator processor module to verify message aggregation logic with various correlation and release strategies.
Implement acceptance tests for the analytic-pmml processor module using a PMML model file and evaluator library to verify scoring and transformation.
Implement acceptance tests for the bridge processor module to verify message bridging between channels and error handling.
Implement acceptance tests for the http-client processor module using WireMock to mock HTTP endpoints and verify request/response handling.
Integrate all acceptance tests into the CI pipeline (e.g., Maven Failsafe plugin configuration), ensure tests run in the correct phase, and verify execution.
Review all test implementations, update README or test documentation, and perform a final sanity check on the complete increment.
